_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 38: 22-26 December 2025. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He describes cabinets he saw that were stored, each one carrying a year and going clear back past the 1970s, says he has been praying over that a lot, and speaks of what is coming for the shaking to awaken across 2026, 2027 and 2028.
mentions.quote: every one of them had a year and it went clear back past the 1970s
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an image of stored years with no content assigned to any of them.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the regrouping in Iran with Syria, Hezbollah and Gaza, and that the Lord said they will pull back, regroup and get ready to retaliate again.
mentions.quote: they will pull back and they'll regroup and get ready to retaliate
mentions.falsify_match: A coordinated retaliation from those actors.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Still no date, five weeks after the first telling.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will bring in regulations and rules concerning crypto in the days ahead, laws that govern it and bring stability so it will not be so volatile.
mentions.quote: They will bring in regulations and they will bring in rules concerning crypto
mentions.falsify_match: Crypto market structure regulation passing.
mentions.falsify_miss: None passes. Legislation already in progress at the time of the telling, so this is close to commentary.

mentions.claim_text: He says that after September the 23rd the Lord told him they had entered the point of no return, and that as labour pains come upon a woman so will it be when the Son of Man returns, pointing at the escalation of things.
mentions.quote: You've entered into the point of no return
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no return from what, and to what, is not specified.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He repeats being told that he will not be able to get away from AI and chatbots and that he must harness it, but must not embrace it or make it his buddy.
mentions.quote: You must harness it. Don't embrace it. Don't make it your buddy
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an instruction about posture toward a technology already in wide use.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says this goes with what the Lord showed them about Canada, Australia and Europe in the days ahead, that they will be the forerunners because America has Trump, and that listeners will be so thankful he is in office.
mentions.quote: they will be the forerunners because we got Trump in there
mentions.falsify_match: Speech or religious restrictions appearing in those countries before America.
mentions.falsify_miss: America moves first. Forerunner is not defined as to what.

mentions.claim_text: He notes that people get cranky around family at the holidays when politics and religion come up, and says he is not changing who he is and will be bold.
mentions.quote: I ain't changing who I am
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says again that the plague will be released in Europe and will affect Europe first, and that it will be released with rats through AI technology, adding that he is not trying to scare people but to prepare them.
mentions.quote: it will be released with rats through AI technology
mentions.falsify_match: An epidemic beginning in Europe with a rodent vector.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The AI delivery mechanism is new here and is not explained.

mentions.claim_text: Asked when the wealth transfer will happen he says he believes it will start happening this year, names 2026, says he is believing God, and expects some kind of plan from Trump.
mentions.quote: I believe that it will start happening this year
mentions.falsify_match: A large-scale transfer of wealth beginning in 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He marks it as belief rather than as a word, which is the honest framing.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are expecting big things in 2026 with only a couple of days of 2025 left, and gives thanks that 2026 will be the year that is exceedingly abundantly above all they dare ask or think.
mentions.quote: 2026 will be the year that will be exceedingly abundantly above all
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no threshold for exceedingly abundantly is given.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He calls their seeds to reap a harvest at last and calls forth abundance to the full until it overflows, saying this will be a time of increase like they have always believed for and that 2026 will be that year.
mentions.quote: WE CALL THEIR SEEDS TO REAP A HARVEST AT LAST
mentions.falsify_match: Reported financial breakthroughs among the audience.
mentions.falsify_miss: None reported. At last acknowledges the harvest has been promised before and has not come.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees buildings and full people, prays for a stretch in tongues, and is told to write the vision down.
mentions.quote: I see buildings. I see the buildings
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: buildings and people, with no place, act or date.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says they prophesied Wyoming back in 2024 and saw the manifestation at the end of 2025, and that the Lord said this would become the norm, so they will start seeing superstorms and long track tornadoes.
mentions.quote: the Lord said this would become the norm
mentions.falsify_match: A rising frequency of long track tornadoes and superstorms.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such rise. The 2024 telling should be in this corpus and can be read against this recall.

mentions.claim_text: He anticipates being called absurd, says that in trying to control the weather they will lose control, and that he saw jet streams and things taking place, major events in the water and earthquakes in diverse places.
mentions.quote: trying to control the weather, they will lose control
mentions.falsify_match: A weather modification programme going visibly wrong.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Earthquakes in diverse places is a scriptural phrase that any year satisfies.

mentions.claim_text: He addresses anyone who wants to make a change and does not want to keep going through life without him, describing an itching on the inside.
mentions.quote: I want to make a change in my life right now
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He urges people to accept Christ now because nobody knows the day they will die, saying the shoes put on to go to work today might be taken off by the undertaker that evening and nobody is promised tomorrow.
mentions.quote: No one knows the day they will die
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He describes someone who tried to weaponise spiritual power, spent money and sacrificed in order to harm them, and persisted even after repeated failure, saying it came back on him.
mentions.quote: He tried to weaponize spiritual power
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an unnamed person and an unobservable act, with the failure itself offered as the evidence.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He speaks about hitting a goal in 2026 and being able to say they did what they were told, and names Cairo, confirming Cairo is in Egypt.
mentions.quote: In Cairo. Cairo. So, Cairo is Egypt, right?
mentions.falsify_match: A stated ministry goal involving Cairo met in 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not. What the Cairo goal is remains unstated in this passage.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls a major uprising in that area involving the man with the black and white checkered hat, and they date it to December 6th, noting it was not too long ago.
mentions.quote: major uprising in that area whenever it was the guy with the checkered hat
mentions.falsify_match: An uprising in the region on or near 6 December 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurred. They are checking their own record on camera, so the earlier telling is in this corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw 150 and the figure was 144, that it is just a little off but the same thing, that this is just the beginning, and that the Lord told him something further about it.
mentions.quote: I saw 150. So 144 150 it's just a little off
mentions.falsify_match: He treats a four percent gap as a match, which is a reasonable call for a wind speed.
mentions.falsify_miss: The number he gave and the number recorded are not the same, and he says so rather than adjusting either.

mentions.claim_text: They check the record and find February the 22nd of 2024, where he said there would be record-breaking wind gusts, and he recalls seeing wind gusts and downbursts.
mentions.quote: he told me there would be recordbreaking wind gust
mentions.falsify_match: Record wind gusts recorded after that date. The 22 February 2024 telling is inside this corpus and can be read directly.
mentions.falsify_miss: No record gusts, or the earlier video does not say what they say it says.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is interesting how everything happening now is the signs of the times of the coming of Christ, that it is escalating as he told them it would, and that the Lord called it the birth pangs.
mentions.quote: it's escalating like I told you would
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: escalation with no measure.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says they do not follow the liberal schools but follow Jesus schools, and that the Lord showed him something he finds interesting.
mentions.quote: we don't follow these liberal schools. We follow Jesus schools
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it sets aside the institutions that would check the claims.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says there are lawsuits coming against Elon with X concerning his platform and freedom of speech, that great censorship is coming against free speech, and that it starts in 2026, comes in 2027 and continues in 2028.
mentions.quote: 2026 it's going to start. 2027 it's gonna come
mentions.falsify_match: Litigation against X over speech moderation.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Suits against X over content rules were already ongoing when he said it.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the septic tank of the heart and of who people are in the church, saying God will take it, and notes that some of these tanks are simply full of filth.
mentions.quote: that septic tank of their heart and who they are in the church
mentions.falsify_match: See the 2026 telling that follows it.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says they will do a deep cleaning and that many of his churches and his people have hidden things inside that septic which they do not know the dirtiness of, and reports being told I am taking the lid off in 2026.
mentions.quote: I'm taking the lid off, son, in 2026
mentions.falsify_match: A run of church scandals surfacing in 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such run. This is the same content as ministry-scandals and first-corinthians-5-5-2026 in a third image.

mentions.claim_text: He says a lot of the elders will go home, that there will be a great transition and a passing of the baton as great prayer warriors who were here step out and go home as they saw this year, but that it will happen even more in 2026.
mentions.quote: a great transition, a passing of the baton
mentions.falsify_match: Notable deaths among older ministry figures in 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: Effectively cannot miss: prominent elderly ministers die every year, and even more is not a number.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw new life coming into them, that their youth would be renewed like the eagles and they would live long and finish strong, and that they are the last generation that will not taste death.
mentions.quote: We are the last generation that will not taste death
mentions.falsify_match: The rapture occurring within this generation.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Sits awkwardly with the same month's statement that it may be twenty years away and with the elders going home in the passage two minutes earlier.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that God is taking the lid off the septic, sucking it out and cleaning things up, asks whether they understand the urgency of the hour, and says it is time to wake up in 2026 and they are going to wake up.
mentions.quote: It's time to wake up in 2026. You're going to wake up
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no measure of a church waking is given.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says that while talking on camera on YouTube he will be translated with others to go to places where Christianity is not allowed, naming Iran and places in the Middle East.
mentions.quote: I will translate you to go to that place
mentions.falsify_match: A documented instance of bodily translation, which would be extraordinary evidence.
mentions.falsify_miss: None documented. No date, and the witnesses would by construction be in closed countries.
